name: SOCI 3990
title: Internship: Field Experience
description: Supervised field experience. Students taking this course will be assigned a final grade of S (satisfactory) or U (unsatisfactory). Hours by arrangement. 42 hours per semester per credit. Repeatable to a maximum of six credits. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: Must be taken with SOCI 3991 concurrently unless continuing an internship already initiated; open to juniors or higher.
